note: Error codes zote (BSOD, Windows, apps, browser, network) + suluhisho. Kila code ina: severity, sababu za kawaida, hatua za kutatua (Kiswahili), na agent inayofaa (sysvision/netdiag/shield).

codes.name: INACCESSIBLE_BOOT_DEVICE
codes.fix_sw: 1) Ingia WinRE → Startup Repair; 2) BIOS: weka SATA mode ile ile ya awali; 3) chkdsk /f /r kutoka recovery; 4) Kama disk inakufa — pull data kwanza (recover.rs)

codes.name: UNMOUNTABLE_BOOT_VOLUME
codes.fix_sw: 1) Angalia/replace cable; 2) chkdsk /r kutoka WinRE; 3) Backup HARAKA kama inafunguka — disk ina dalili za kufa

codes.name: MEMORY_MANAGEMENT
codes.fix_sw: 1) Windows Memory Diagnostic (mdsched.exe); 2) Reseat RAM / test stick moja moja; 3) Rekebisha overclock kuwa defaults

codes.name: DRIVER_IRQL_NOT_LESS_OR_EQUAL
codes.fix_sw: 1) Soma jina la driver kwenye BSOD; 2) Safe Mode → rollback/update driver huyo; 3) Uninstall AV ya mtu wa tatu kama ndiyo chanzo

codes.name: PAGE_FAULT_IN_NONPAGED_AREA
codes.fix_sw: 1) Test RAM; 2) Safe Mode → uninstall AV/updates za hivi karibuni; 3) sfc /scannow + DISM

codes.name: WHEA_UNCORRECTABLE_ERROR
codes.fix_sw: 1) Angalia joto (vision); 2) Rekebisha overclock; 3) Angalia PSU; 4) Hardware diagnosis ya kina (onsite)

codes.name: CRITICAL_PROCESS_DIED
codes.fix_sw: 1) sfc /scannow; 2) DISM /Online /Cleanup-Image /RestoreHealth; 3) shield scan; 4) System Restore kama ipo

codes.name: CRITICAL_OBJECT_TERMINATION
codes.fix_sw: 1) Angalia Event Viewer; 2) shield scan (malware); 3) chkdsk; 4) Test RAM

codes.name: SYSTEM_THREAD_EXCEPTION_NOT_HANDLED
codes.fix_sw: 1) Safe Mode; 2) Uninstall updates/drivers za hivi karibuni; 3) Update drivers kutoka tovuti rasmi

codes.name: DRIVER_POWER_STATE_FAILURE
causes: Driver haishiki power states (mara nyingi WiFi/graphics)
codes.fix_sw: 1) Update/rollback driver ya network/graphics; 2) Zima Fast Startup kwa muda

codes.name: DPC_WATCHDOG_VIOLATION
codes.fix_sw: 1) Update SSD firmware + storage driver; 2) Angalia compatibility ya Windows version

codes.name: BAD_POOL_CALLER
codes.fix_sw: 1) Uninstall VPN/AV za hivi karibuni; 2) Test RAM; 3) Driver Verifier (kwa wataalam)

codes.name: Haiwezi kuboot (loop)
codes.fix_sw: 1) WinRE → Startup Repair (mara 2-3); 2) Safe Mode → uninstall update; 3) System Restore; 4) Reset PC (Keep files) kama zote zimeshindikana

codes.name: Preparing Automatic Repair loop
codes.fix_sw: 1) WinRE cmd: bootrec /fixmbr; bootrec /fixboot; bootrec /rebuildbcd; 2) chkdsk C: /f /r; 3) System Restore

codes.name: File haipatikani (Update/Backup)
codes.fix_sw: 1) Futa SoftwareDistribution\Download; 2) sfc /scannow; 3) Windows Update Troubleshooter

codes.name: File au directory imeharibika
codes.fix_sw: 1) chkdsk /f /r; 2) Test RAM; 3) Kama USB boot media — tengeneza upya

codes.name: Out of memory / resources
codes.fix_sw: 1) Task Manager → tafuta process inayokula RAM; 2) Ongeza pagefile; 3) Restart; 4) RAM upgrade

codes.name: Access denied
codes.fix_sw: 1) Run as administrator; 2) Angalia AV quarantine; 3) Take ownership: icacls / takeown

codes.name: Unspecified error (E_FAIL)
causes: Kila kitu kinaweza — kawaida permissions au corruption
codes.fix_sw: 1) Run as admin; 2) sfc /scannow; 3) Angalia Event Viewer kwa kosa la kweli

codes.name: Upgrade failure (0xC1900101)
codes.fix_sw: 1) Ondoa AV ya mtu wa tatu; 2) Futa drivers za zamani; 3) Hakikisha 20GB+ nafasi; 4) Clean boot kisha upgrade

codes.name: Browser: connection refused
codes.fix_sw: 1) netdiag → angalia L3/L4; 2) Ondoa proxy (Settings→Proxy); 3) Firewall rules

codes.name: DNS haifanyi kazi
codes.fix_sw: 1) Badilisha DNS: 8.8.8.8 / 1.1.1.1; 2) ipconfig /flushdns; 3) ANGALIA hosts file (C:\Windows\System32\drivers\etc\hosts) — malware huiongeza entries!

codes.name: Connection timeout
codes.fix_sw: 1) netdiag (L1→L4); 2) Jaribu mtandao mwingine/hotspot; 3) Angalia kama site zote au moja

codes.name: SSL/Certificate error
codes.fix_sw: 1) ANGALIA TAREHE+SAA KWANZA (kosa la kawaida!); 2) Clear SSL cache; 3) Kama inajirudia kwenye sites zote — shield scan (MITM malware)

codes.name: Domain haipatikani
codes.fix_sw: 1) ipconfig /flushdns; 2) Badilisha DNS; 3) Angalia spelling ya domain

codes.name: Edge/IE haipati resources
codes.fix_sw: 1) Reset browser; 2) netdiag; 3) Ondoa proxy settings

codes.name: Windows Update download failure
codes.fix_sw: 1) netdiag; 2) Futa SoftwareDistribution; 3) Update mara moja kwa hotspot kama ISP inazuia

codes.name: Activation haipati KMS
codes.fix_sw: 1) Rekebisha saa/tarehe; 2) slmgr /skms <server>; slmgr /ato; 3) Kama license halali — slmgr /rearm (mara chache tu)

codes.name: Program inajifunga kila wakati
codes.fix_sw: 1) Uninstall→restart→install safi; 2) Install .NET/VC++ redistributables; 3) Add exception kwenye AV; 4) Run as admin

codes.name: Boot inachukua zaidi ya dakika 2
codes.fix_sw: 1) shield audit → startup entries; 2) Zima zisizoza lazima (Task Manager→Startup); 3) SSD upgrade (badiliko kubwa)

codes.name: Dalili za ransomware (note ya malipo/simamisha files)
codes.fix_sw: 1) ZIMISHA PC KWA MTANDAO MARA MOJA; 2) USILIPISHE — hakuna dhamana; 3) Tafuta ID ya ransomware kwenye note (id-ransomware.malwarebytes.com); 4) Kama backup ipo — wipe + restore; 5) shields up: shield audit

codes.name: hosts file imebadilishwa (redirects)
codes.fix_sw: 1) Fungua C:\Windows\System32\drivers\etc\hosts (Notepad as admin); 2) Futa entries zisizo za default (localhost tu); 3) shield scan; 4) Badilisha password za accounts
